owner_scale: kilkanaście twórców i 10 tys. widzów, odpowiedź na pytanie o szczyt jednoczesnych widzów
SQL_template_adapter: Official installed @prisma/client/runtime/library sqltag/join/raw/empty; namespace explicitly supplied only in research VM; nothing installed/replaced
SQL_cleanup: ROLLBACK; temp tables only; no persistent fixture or schema mutation
SQL_limits: one observation per case/size; no percentile or concurrent capacity
channel-name lookup, hydrate, facets, Prisma, network and HTTP excluded
local temp buffers, synthetic text/data distribution and host differ from production
PeerTube not executed; no comparative benchmark
harness_history: Initial SQL capture git subprocess hit sandbox EPERM before evidence; switched research guard to archived baseline hashes. Final capture/SQL/model/summary probes exit 0. No app edits. Model regenerated after owner clarified small creator count and 10000 peak viewers.
cost_model: conditional R2+Workers only; 10 arithmetic invariants, no invoice/compute quote or measured scale
loadtest_probe: 4 synthetic summaries; exits 0/0/11/10; actual HMAC helper with synthetic key differs from cleanup plain SHA

peertube_partial_review.scope: Selected queue concurrency/global distinction, local/remote builder selection, job dependencies, runner cancel/failure, stored search vector/trigram candidates, process roles, pool size and opt-in replica/read-your-writes boundaries. Not full-file review.
limitations: More distributed dependencies and consistency work; not automatic fault tolerance
Read-your-writes Redis recording catches write-record errors; no outage proof
FTS+trigram semantics differ; no equal workload or query benchmark
